palette.neutrals: platform --bg / --surface-solid (white and pale grey; near-black in dark)

type.numbers: ui-rounded 760 tabular (ages: big numbers, small units)

layout: Header with a speech-bubble mark; a hero row with the quote composer (bubble-shaped textarea, kid avatar chips) beside a spotlight card that brings back an on-this-day or random quote; a full-width timeline; then all quotes as speech-bubble cards in a responsive grid with avatar, context, age and date underneath. Stacks composer, spotlight, timeline, list on phones.
signature: 'Growing up, in their words': one life line per kid from birth to today, birthday ticks labelled with ages, a dot per quote in the kid's colour; tapping a dot brings that quote into the spotlight.
mood: Warm, playful and kid-sized: rounded type, speech bubbles, one colour per child on neutral paper.
